name: Elon Musk
description: Follow Elon Musk, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Elon Musk donates over $150 million to Senate GOP group, assisting Ken Paxton
changes.summary: Billionaire Elon Musk is offering a nine-figure assist to Texas GOP Senate candidate Ken Paxton, a decisive return to large-scale political giving for the world's richest man.

changes.title: The Tesla Roadster flew, drove upside down, and hit 60mph in under a second
changes.summary: Elon Musk promised a flying car. And the Tesla Roadster did exactly that. Tesla demonstrated its next-generation Roadster at an event in Waco, Texas, where the electric supercar drove upside down, briefly flew, and accelerated to 60mph in under a second. It was an impressive demonstration of a car that likely will come.

changes.title: Elon Musk and Other Donors Pile $94 Million Into House Republican Effort
changes.summary: The party’s top super PAC for House candidates said it had raised more this summer than ever before in a third quarter, but acknowledged the challenges Republicans are facing.

changes.title: What Is Starshield, SpaceX’s Military-Grade Satellite Internet Service Ukraine Relies On?
changes.summary: For years, Ukraine’s armed forces have relied on satellite communication services developed by Elon Musk’s SpaceX. Recent restrictions have hampered its war effort.

changes.title: How Starlink disruptions affected Ukraine's battlefield operations
changes.summary: A key component of Ukraine's communications network was partially disabled on Wednesday. The Starshield satellite network, funded by the Pentagon and operated by Elon Musk's SpaceX, was not operating at full capacity, hampering communications within the Ukrainian military. Liz Landers reports and Amna Nawaz discusses t.

changes.title: Ukraine accuses SpaceX of restricting Starlink, disrupting military amid Trump pressure
changes.summary: Ukrainian officials and military units accused Elon Musk’s SpaceX of throttling a technology at the heart of their battlefield communications and drone operations.

changes.title: Volodymyr Zelenskyy feels ‘betrayed’ by Donald Trump over Starlink access
changes.summary: Ukrainian president accused US president of picking the other side after four years of war Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said he feels personally betrayed by Donald Trump after it emerged that Ukraine’s military has had its access to Elon Musk’s Starlink satellite squeezed, raising doubts about long-term US support for Kyiv.

changes.title: Is Universal Basic Income the Answer to A.I.-Fueled Job Losses?
changes.summary: For more than a year, The New York Times followed recipients of universal basic income programs, which Elon Musk and other tech leaders have promoted as a solution to A.I.-fueled job losses.
